sessions.title: The Island Event Becomes a Shareable World
sessions.description: Translate the brochure's Island GTC and poker-run/FIFA-inspired ideas into a proposed interactive event concept; their intended meanings remain to be confirmed.
sessions.outcome: Demonstrate the interactive concept and specify the approvals and production needed for a real event.
sessions.specialists: Event/marine safety operator; interactive developer; local cultural producer

sessions.title: Can This Project Be Shared? A Live Rights Review
sessions.description: Make ownership, permissions, responsibilities, and reuse understandable before a shared island project grows.
sessions.outcome: Walk through a fictional reuse request and show what is permitted, missing, or jurisdiction-dependent.
sessions.specialists: USVI/BVI-qualified counsel as applicable; local rights/data owner

sessions.title: An AI Workflow People Know How to Govern
sessions.description: Draft a human-centered adoption policy that connects training, accountability, and permitted AI use; specialist attribution remains provisional pending bio confirmation.
sessions.outcome: Demonstrate the policy in a scenario and identify decisions still requiring authorized approval.
sessions.specialists: Employment/AI counsel; worker representative; local institution owner

sessions.title: The Place OS Pilot Readiness Review
sessions.description: Connect the Place OS modules into a small operational demonstration with an honest continuity plan.
sessions.outcome: Present the working slice, failure behavior, owners, and a proposed 90-day pilot scope.
sessions.specialists: Telecom/cloud operator; local pilot owner; security engineer

sessions.title: The Institution's Before-and-After Demo
sessions.description: Apply the knowledge and evaluation layers to one institution's selected low-risk administrative workflow.
sessions.outcome: Show the workflow, measured prototype results, and the institution's proposed next validation step.
sessions.specialists: Named local institution process owner; implementation team

sessions.title: One Journey, Local Value: The Live Demo
sessions.description: Join arrival, stay, food, and experience modules into one limited end-to-end demonstration.
sessions.outcome: Show the complete test itinerary, disruption response, supplier value, and proposed pilot commitments.
sessions.specialists: Destination operator; reservation/integration engineer; local experience provider

sessions.title: The Place as a World: Makers' Showcase
sessions.description: Package the pillar's samples into a small screening/playable showcase with an explicit follow-on opportunity for local participants.
sessions.outcome: Present the collection and proposed partner next steps while separating permissions from pending approvals.
sessions.specialists: Distributor/streaming or museum partner; local creator representative; rights reviewer

sessions.title: The Rules That Let the Build Travel
sessions.description: Assemble the pillar's discussion drafts into one portable but locally adaptable pilot kit.
sessions.outcome: Present the kit, its unresolved approvals, and a proposed pilot decision meeting after the summit.
sessions.specialists: Named host and original builder; qualified local counsel; implementation owner

sessions.title: Live Stress Test: Can the Island Keep Working?
sessions.description: Keep essential island services usable through outages and disconnected systems. Bring the Place Operating System into a practical resilience story.
sessions.outcome: Run a simulated outage, show recovery, and disclose unresolved dependencies.
sessions.specialists: Local service owner; infrastructure integration engineer

sessions.title: Island Talent, Live and Interactive
sessions.description: Connect local sport and cultural talent to a participatory fan experience with clear ownership, safeguarding, and realistic reach.
sessions.outcome: Let attendees try the experience and assess access, engagement, and next steps; no named sports partnership is implied.
sessions.specialists: Interactive-experience developer; local talent/community partner; safeguarding lead

modes.name: Conference powerboat
modes.summary: Five islands per day · conditional target
modes.description: Follow the same five circuit series through Problem, Solution, Build, and Showcase. Travel east on January 26 and 28, west on January 27 and 29, and stay at the endpoint. Estimates assume a suitable fast passenger vessel at roughly 20–25 knots where permitted and practical.
modes.warning: The 75-minute gaps are shorter than the upper estimates for the international and some Jost–Scrub transfers. Five daily stops cannot be guaranteed; a carrier-approved plan or more time is needed. These are planning estimates, not reserved departures.

modes.name: Ferries & resort launches
modes.summary: All five islands across four days
modes.description: A regional alternative with scheduled services, taxis, and resort launches. It switches between featured series and misses some stages. Published departures are references, not January 2027 reservations.
modes.warning: Five islands every day does not fit the reviewed schedules. Lovango and Scrub services require reservations and eligible guest access or a conference agreement. Independent connections are not guaranteed.

days.start: Start near Red Hook, St. Thomas.
days.mapDescription: Ferries & resort launches, Jan 26 · The Problem. St. Thomas 9:00am to 9:45am; Lovango 11:00am to 11:45am; St. John 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Red Hook → Lovango
items.detail: Published resort departure; 15–30-minute crossing. Only 15 minutes after Tech for walking and boarding: the operator must approve this connection, or omit the 9am session. Resort access must be reserved.

items.title: Lovango → Cruz Bay
items.detail: Published resort departure and approximately 10-minute crossing. Have lunch on Lovango first; allow arrival/venue access on St. John. This misses the 1pm circuit feature; attend the 5pm second feature instead.

days.mapDescription: Ferries & resort launches, Jan 27 · The Plan / Solution. St. John 9:00am to 9:45am; Lovango 11:00am to 11:45am; St. Thomas 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Cruz Bay → Lovango
items.detail: Published resort departure and approximately 10-minute crossing. Reserve/check in before departure. Only about 15 minutes from arrival to the 11am session: a nearby venue is essential.

items.title: Lovango → Red Hook
items.detail: Published resort departure. Allow 15–30 minutes underway, boarding/check-in before departure, and venue access on arrival. Lunch before departure; free time before Tech.

days.start: Check in at Red Hook by 7:30am; confirm the carrier’s requirements.
days.mapDescription: Ferries & resort launches, Jan 28 · Build. Jost Van Dyke 3:00pm to 3:45pm

items.title: Red Hook → West End, Tortola · international
items.detail: Tourism-board-listed departure, not a January booking. Estimate 45–60 minutes underway plus 30–90+ minutes clearance/arrival. Target the later 1pm connection rather than relying on the 10am boat.

items.title: West End → Great Harbour, Jost
items.detail: Published New Horizon departure; crossing estimated 20–30 minutes. Allow 30-minute check-in and nearby venue access.

items.title: Jost → West End → Trellis Bay → Scrub
items.detail: Published 5pm ferry; estimate 20–30 minutes underway, 10–15 to meet the driver, 45–75 by prebooked taxi, and 15 for launch check-in. Target the 6:45pm resort launch (10-minute crossing); 7:45pm may be needed. Reserve resort access and confirm connections.

days.overnight: Jost Van Dyke; next-day departure separately arranged.
days.mapDescription: Ferries & resort launches, Jan 29 · Showcase. Scrub Island 9:00am to 9:45am; Jost Van Dyke 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Scrub → Trellis Bay → West End → Jost
items.detail: Published launch: approximately 10 minutes. Allow disembarkation, 45–75 minutes by taxi across Tortola, and 30-minute ferry check-in. Target the published 1pm West End ferry, estimated Jost arrival 1:20–1:30pm. A listed 4pm ferry may be a fallback for a nearby 5pm venue, subject to availability.

modes.name: Sailing yacht / catamaran
modes.summary: All five islands across four days
modes.description: A cruising alternative with overnight accommodation aboard at authorized locations. Estimates assume approximately six knots underway. A fast motor yacht belongs in the powerboat comparison. This agenda skips some stages of the featured series.
modes.warning: Sailing cannot fit five daily islands into the proposed two-hour start intervals. Berths, tender landings, weather, and captain-approved passages must be arranged. A separate fast launch would use the powerboat scenario’s limits.

days.start: Start near Red Hook; yacht and crew ready for departure.
days.mapDescription: Sailing yacht / catamaran, Jan 26 · The Problem. St. Thomas 9:00am to 9:45am; Lovango 3:00pm to 3:45pm

items.title: Red Hook → Lovango
items.detail: Estimate 30–60 minutes underway plus 30–45 for berthing/tendering and shore access: 60–105 minutes total. Lunch and free time before Law.

items.title: Lovango → Cruz Bay
items.detail: Estimate 20–40 minutes underway plus 30–45 for berthing/shore access: 50–85 minutes total. Do not count on reaching the 5pm AI session.

days.mapDescription: Sailing yacht / catamaran, Jan 27 · The Plan / Solution. St. John 9:00am to 9:45am; Jost Van Dyke 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Cruz Bay → Great Harbour · international
items.detail: Estimate 80–110 minutes underway plus 60–120 for international formalities and shore access: 2h20–3h50+ total. Lunch and time ashore before the 5pm feature.

days.overnight: Scrub marina or another approved nearby berth.
days.mapDescription: Sailing yacht / catamaran, Jan 28 · Build. Scrub Island 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Jost Van Dyke → Scrub Island
items.detail: Estimate 2h20–3h underway plus 30–60 minutes berthing/tendering and shore access: 2h50–4h total. The 11am feature is optional only if actual arrival permits; this agenda selects 5pm.

days.overnight: Authorized Jost berth/mooring; next-day exit separately arranged.
days.mapDescription: Sailing yacht / catamaran, Jan 29 · Showcase. Scrub Island 9:00am to 9:45am; Jost Van Dyke 5:00pm to 5:45pm

items.title: Scrub Island → Jost Van Dyke
items.detail: Allow 2h50–4h including sailing and shore access. Lunch before the 5pm feature.
